prompt.generated_prompt_string: Two adults sit side by side on the edge of a tidy bed in a softly lit bedroom with light gray pleated curtains. The adult man wears a white long-sleeve shirt and black trousers; the adult woman wears a Japanese-inspired uniform with a white shirt, dark-blue bow tie, pleated skirt, and black stockings. From 0-1 seconds, she holds a snack bag and eats while he stares ahead as if watching TV. From 1-4 seconds, he reaches into the snack bag, takes a snack, and chews. From 4-5 seconds, he reaches again but misses the bag, his hand landing briefly on the blanket near her knee; he immediately realizes the mistake. From 5-6 seconds, freeze the image as she looks from the hand to his face and gives a knowing comedic smirk while he stiffens. From 6-9 seconds, she puts down the bag and playfully chases him across the bed; he raises both hands apologetically and retreats. Use subtitles for the source beats and dynamic comedic music, with no intimate touching or straddling.
